title: RNA containing modified nucleosides and methods of use thereof
assignee_title: The Trustees of the University of Pennsylvania
assignee: The Trustees of the University of Pennsylvania
claim_1: 1. A method for inducing a mammalian cell to produce a protein of interest comprising: contacting said mammalian cell with in vitro-synthesized modified RNA encoding a protein of interest, wherein said in vitro-synthesized modified RNA comprises the modified nucleoside pseudouridine.

title: RNA containing modified nucleosides and methods of use thereof
assignee_title: The Trustees of the University of Pennsylvania
assignee: The Trustees of the University of Pennsylvania
claim_1: 1. A method comprising: replacing at least one uridine nucleotide of in vitro-synthesized RNA, comprising an open reading frame that encodes a recombinant protein of interest, with a nucleotide comprising the modified nucleoside 5-methoxyuridine (mo 5 U), thereby generating in vitro-synthesized RNA comprising mo 5 U in place of the at least one uridine nucleotide.

title: RNA containing modified nucleosides and methods of use thereof
assignee_title: The Trustees of the University of Pennsylvania
assignee: The Trustees of the University of Pennsylvania
claim_1: 1. A method for inducing a mammalian cell to produce a protein of interest, the method comprising: contacting said mammalian cell with an in vitro-synthesized modified RNA encoding the protein of interest, wherein the in vitro-synthesized modified RNA encoding the protein of interest is translated by the cell, and wherein said in vitro-synthesized modified-RNA comprises the modified nucleoside 5-methylcytidine (m 5 C).
